# Lawlor, White & Murphey Personal Injury Lawyers

> Fort Lauderdale-based personal injury law firm providing comprehensive legal representation for accident victims, medical malpractice, and wrongful death claims across South Florida.

Lawlor, White & Murphey is a full-service personal injury firm with experienced attorneys recognized by the Florida Justice Association and Million Dollar Advocates Forum. The firm serves clients throughout South Florida including Fort Lauderdale, Broward County, and Palm Beach County with free case evaluations and contingency-based representation.
